title: Touch and Count
short: Say one number for each thing you touch.
trouble: Children touch one thing twice or skip one.

blocks.html: When we count things, we touch each one and say one number. One touch, one number. No skipping and no touching twice!

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Tap each duck as you count. A tapped duck shows its number.

blocks.html: Touch each thing once and say one number for it.

blocks.title: Counting buttons
blocks.q: Three buttons sit on the table. Count them.

blocks.html: For the grown-up: Move each thing as you count it, from one pile to another, or drop it in a cup. Moving makes it easy to see what is counted. Gently guide your child’s finger at first. Keep screen time short: two or three problems, then play.

items: Try it at home: Count spoons as you set the table.
Drop blocks into a box: one, two, three …
